scopeNote: This is a re-scope of the 1 Sep 2026 pack, which catalogued only Cardiff Central and Severn Tunnel Junction and excluded Transport for Wales Valley Lines entirely on a since-corrected premise ("no confirmed public feed"). The walk-up rule (docs/board-eligibility-rule.md) requires Darwin coverage, not a separate TfW feed - Darwin carries Valley Lines departures at every catalog station (live-probed 5 Sep 2026). Catalog now covers 16 walk-up-boardable National Rail stations spanning Cardiff-area Valley Lines and the South Wales Main Line mainline corridor from Severn Tunnel Junction (Wales-England boundary) to Swansea (western boundary of this region; Llanelli/Carmarthen stay Rest of Wales per the ledger).
notes: D1 oracle is docs/south-wales-d1/oracle-clash-report.md, re-scoped 7 Sep 2026. No product lib/cities/south-wales/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.

Catalog: 16 stations total. Hub lock Cardiff Central (CDF). Secondary hub Cardiff Queen Street (CDQ). Third-tier local hub Pontypridd (PPD). Valley Lines termini: Merthyr Tydfil (MER), Aberdare (ABA), Treherbert (TRB), Rhymney (RHY). Valley Lines local station: Caerphilly (CPH). National Rail mainline: Newport (NWP), Swansea (SWA, boundary), Bridgend (BGN), Neath (NTH), Port Talbot Parkway (PTA). National Rail branches: Barry Island (BYI), Penarth (PEN). Through-running boundary: Severn Tunnel Junction (STJ).

No doNotGroup pair built at Cardiff Central or between Cardiff Central and Cardiff Queen Street - see hazard-pack.md H4/H6/doNotGroup proposals. CDF is a single Darwin CRS/board carrying both Valley Lines and mainline operators (operator-mixed, like any multi-TOC UK hub); CDQ is a separate CRS/board ~600 m away with no shared-board evidence found - two plain entries, not a group.

Severn Tunnel Junction (STJ) vs Chepstow (CPW) boundary discrepancy from the 1 Sep 2026 pack is RESOLVED per docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md SS2 (Tim, 5 Sep 2026): both stations are in Wales, on different corridors (STJ = South Wales Main Line; CPW = Gloucester-Newport/Wye Valley line), both home South Wales, both stay through-running-only. No catalog change needed.

Catalog boundary: Swansea (SWA) is the westernmost mainline hub in this region. Neath (NTH) and Port Talbot Parkway (PTA) are the westernmost stations short of Swansea. Llanelli (LLE) and Carmarthen (CMN) are Rest of Wales's per docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md SS2 stop ownership and are NOT catalogued here. Rest of Wales's own pack is untouched by this rescope (propagation rule, docs/country-lane.md).

Direction model: Valley Lines = line + terminus, termini-only (not a full stop-order model - only 4 of 6 line termini have a confirmed CRS in this 16-station catalog; Coryton and Ebbw Vale termini are not yet catalogued). National Rail mainline/through-running = destination + operator, illustrative only pending a live Darwin destination-string pull. See direction-model-memo.md.
Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences by CRS, pulled 7 Sep 2026 via scripts/lib/uk-naptan.mjs; 16/16 stations geocoded, no exceptions, no null coordinates. See stationList below for lat/lng per station.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until Jim wires the adapter and Mark's QA checklist is green. This pack does not flip anything.

Attribution to Rail Delivery Group required. National Rail static GTFS (Transitland) is CC-BY-2.0 UK, confidence 'clear', reference-only.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Cardiff Central is the hub lock (report C2/C3 point 2). Cardiff Queen Street is a secondary hub, catalogued as a separate plain entry - not grouped with Cardiff Central and not referred to as plain 'Cardiff' (ambiguous with Cardiff Central). See hazard-pack.md H6 for why no doNotGroup rule is built between the two, or within Cardiff Central's Valley-Lines/mainline mix.

coverageGaps: Coryton line and Ebbw Vale line termini are named in the report's D1 summary as two of the six Valley Lines routes but have no CRS confirmed in this pack's 16-station live-probed table - not catalogued, not modelled. Flagged for a future catalog-expansion pass (report line 50's secondary tier).

National Rail mainline destination strings (e.g. exact Darwin headsigns for London/Bristol/North Wales/West Wales services) are illustrative only pending a live Darwin destination-string pull - see direction-model-memo.md.
Valley Lines on-board terminus display strings are illustrative only pending a live Darwin trip_headsign pull for each of the four modelled termini (MER, ABA, TRB, RHY).
No intermediate Valley Lines halt stop-order is given for any of the six lines - termini-only direction model, not a full stop-order model. See direction-model-memo.md.

National Rail licensing redistribution-to-third-parties question: RESOLVED per report's License section (Tim read the signed RDM DSA, 5 Sep 2026) - recorded here only so this pack does not re-flag it as open.
